modules.title: 功能清单怎样整理成有目标的 Now、Next、Later 路线图
产品路线图怎样表达方向

items.title: 从目标和用户结果开始
items.text: 先写希望改善什么问题与结果，再放入支持该目标的功能，避免让功能名称代替产品判断。

items.title: 用时间范围保留调整空间
items.text: 近期可以更明确，远期通常使用季度或 Now、Next、Later，并随着证据和约束变化持续更新。

items.title: 让日常工作能够追溯
items.text: 路线图中的方向可以连接 {c:product-backlog} 和具体需求，让协作者知道当前工作支持哪个目标。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:product-roadmap} 说明产品为什么向某个方向发展；{c:product-backlog} 排列可能要完成的具体工作；{c:gantt-chart} 展示已经选定任务的起止时间和依赖。路线图里的时间范围不自动等于交付承诺。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪份计划最接近产品路线图？

options.label: Now：减少行程丢失；Next：让同行者一起编辑；Later：验证自动规划需求，并为每阶段标出预期用户结果
options.feedback: 对。它用时间范围表达目标、方向和预期成果，较远阶段仍保留调整空间。

options.label: 列出未来六周每位开发者每天编写哪个文件，以及精确到小时的完成时间
options.feedback: 这是任务排期，主要回答谁在什么时候完成什么，不是产品路线图的战略视角。

options.label: 把所有人提过的功能放进一张没有目标、顺序和时间范围的清单
options.feedback: 没有方向与取舍的功能清单不能说明产品准备怎样演进。

en.title: Which plan is closest to a product roadmap?

options.label: Now: reduce lost itineraries; Next: support co-editing; Later: validate demand for automatic planning, with an expected user outcome for each horizon
options.feedback: Correct. It uses time horizons to communicate goals, direction, and expected outcomes while leaving distant work adjustable.

options.label: List the exact file each developer will edit every day for six weeks, with hourly completion times
options.feedback: That is task scheduling. It answers who does what and when, not how the product should evolve.

options.label: Put every suggested feature into a list without goals, order, or time horizons
options.feedback: An unordered wish list cannot communicate product direction or tradeoffs.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请根据这些已经确认的产品目标、用户证据和约束，整理一份 Now、Next、Later 产品路线图。每个阶段写清要解决的问题、预期用户结果和候选工作；把没有依据的功能和日期标成待确认。说明主要取舍与依赖，但不要把较远阶段写成固定交付承诺，也不要展开每天的任务排期。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Using these confirmed product goals, user evidence, and constraints, create a Now–Next–Later product roadmap. For each horizon, state the problem, expected user outcome, and candidate work. Mark unsupported features and dates as open questions. Explain major tradeoffs and dependencies without turning distant horizons into fixed commitments or daily task schedules.

learning.assumes: You have seen quarterly feature lists that do not explain goals or distinguish forecasts from commitments.
learning.outcome: You can organize a roadmap around goals, expected outcomes, and time horizons, then distinguish it from a product backlog, PRD, and Gantt chart.

modules.title: Turn a feature list into a goal-led Now–Next–Later roadmap
How a product roadmap communicates direction

items.title: Start with goals and user outcomes
items.text: State the problem and desired result before listing the work that may support it.

items.title: Use horizons to preserve flexibility
items.text: Near-term work can be clearer; distant work uses broader horizons and changes with evidence.

items.title: Make daily work traceable
items.text: Connect roadmap direction to the {c:product-backlog} and specific requirements.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A {c:product-roadmap} explains direction, a {c:product-backlog} orders candidate work, and a {c:gantt-chart} schedules selected tasks. A roadmap horizon is not automatically a delivery commitment.
